owned[0][\"payload\"][\"nested\"].append(\"late\")
assert cache.search(\"t1\", q, \"v1\", 2)[0][\"payload\"][\"nested\"] == [\"source\"]
assert len(calls) == 1
assert cache.search(\"t2\", q, \"v1\", 2)[0][\"id\"] == \"one\"
assert cache.search(\"t1\", q, \"v2\", 2)[0][\"id\"] == \"one\"
assert len(calls) == 3
result = cache.search(\"t1\", q, \"v1\", 3)
result[0][\"payload\"][\"nested\"].append(\"caller\")
assert cache.search(\"t1\", q, \"v1\", 3)[0][\"payload\"][\"nested\"] == [\"source\"]
assert len(calls) == 4

for bad in (0, -1, True, 1.5):
    try:
        RetrievalCache(src, ttl=bad)
    except ValueError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError(f\"accepted ttl {bad"'!r}")
print("extended retrieval cache checks passed")'"'"
